thread:
ana: heads up — publish CI for js-sdk failed on typegen regen. seems like a semver/changelog mismatch blocked npm publish.

mike: ugh. which repo? js-sdk or sdk-core?

ana: js-sdk (packages/js). CI log says uncommitted changes after running yarn typegen:regen. Also package.json is still at 1.2.0 but the changelog has an entry for 1.3.0.

sam: ci-bot output: `ERROR: Uncommitted generator diffs detected. Run "yarn typegen:regen" and commit changes. Aborting publish.`

liz: I think this came from the auth/retry tweak — we added an optional RetryPolicy type which changed generated types. That should be a patch bump, not minor, but changelog PR already referenced v1.3.0. Someone bumped the changelog but didn't update package.json.

mike: ah classic. release flow created the changelog entry automatically (release-drafter) but the semver step failed because commit with version bump never made it out of my local branch.

ana: repro steps I ran locally: `git checkout main && yarn && yarn typegen:regen` yields diffs in `packages/js/src/generated/*` and `packages/js/package.json` still 1.2.0.

liz: suggestion: create a tiny PR that 1) runs regen, 2) bumps package.json to 1.2.1, 3) updates changelog heading to match 1.2.1. Keep it patch.

mike: I'll open PR — will include commit message `chore(js): regen types + patch version bump` and reference #1234. Does anyone object to patch instead of minor?

sam: no objections. patch sounds right for auth/retry typing adjustments.

codegen-bot: tag v1.3.0 was previously created for draft release by release workflow — this conflicts with package.json. Recommend removing draft tag or aligning release metadata.

ana: good catch. if the tag exists in remote it will block npm dist-tag flow. I'm going to check remote tags and delete the erroneous v1.3.0 draft if it's not used.

mike: PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/189 — includes regen, bump to 1.2.1, updated changelog. CI triggered.

ci-bot: build queued for PR #189. Running typegen check and npm pack verification.

liz: after this lands, can we add a guard to release workflow that refuses changelog edits without a version bump? I think the mismatch is a recurring footgun.

ana: Agreed — also adding a `yarn typegen:check` as a prepublish step in the js-sdk package.json would stop this earlier. I'll file follow-ups unless someone else wants to.

mike: will merge once CI is green. thanks for quick triage. :thumbsup:

ana: thanks — following up to delete stray tag and add the prepublish check once this is done.

sam: noted in triage board: TASK-857 (prepublish typegen check)

mike: CI passed, merging now.

ci-bot: PR #189 merged by mike. New publish job queued.

ana: publish succeeded, package 1.2.1 now live. closing thread. :party:
